objective: Candidate sifts ceramic media from retained washers; PR 1262 empties a robot-vacuum dustbin into a waste box and reinstalls the bin.
physical_skill: PR 1262 tests lifting a bin, holding it over a target, operating a release button, trap-door discharge, and precise reseating. The candidate tests two-tab load sharing and orientation-sensitive selective screening.
success_condition: PR 1262 rewards dust-ball transfer, closed doors, bin seating, and arm return. The candidate requires high media recovery while every washer remains in the screen, followed by supported release and dwell.
reason: PR 1262 is bulk discharge through actuated doors; it does not test simultaneous pass-through and retention based on body geometry.
